units: Targ. O. ib. XLI, 43; a. fr.—Freq. אַבָּא (also in Hebr. phraseol.) my father.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:3">B. Bath. IX, 3</cite>; a. fr.
Meg. 12ᵇ אהורייריה דא׳ my father’s steward. אבי א׳ my grandfather.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 113a:16">Snh. 113ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ אליהו</he> father Elijah (sarcastically).—<he>אָבוֹהֵ ד־</he>, <he>אָבוֹי ד־</he> N.’s father.
Ber. 18ᵇ; Y. B. Mets. IV, 9ᶜ top; a. fr.—א׳ סב, א׳ רבה grandfather. Targ. II, Esth. VII, 10.

<cite ref="Shabbat 22a:4">Sabb. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אֲבוּהוֹן דכולהון דם</he> the source of all analogous cases is the law about blood (that you must cover it from a sense of propriety).—Pl. <he>אֲבָהָן</he>, <cite ref="A00052"><he>אֲבָהָתָא</he></cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 24:16">Targ. Y. Deut. XXIV, 16</cite>.
